points: Bitkom Research phone survey of 602 German firms (20+ staff); 96% import digital tech or services
73% worry about US dependence (38% in 2024), 79% about China (69%)
44% now favour German or European providers; 40% prepare to switch providers
take: Fresh German board-level data on dependency: worry about US suppliers nearly doubled since 2024. Useful benchmark for exit plans and EU provider shortlists before the Digital-Gipfel.
title: Bitkom: firms could last 16 months without digital imports
